The requested certificate would constitute an explicit counterexample to Keller’s Jacobian conjecture: a polynomial map \(F:\mathbb C^3\to\mathbb C^3\) with \(\det JF\in\mathbb C^\times\) that is not injective. The degree bound \(\deg F_i\le 7\) does not change this fundamental obstruction.

No such counterexample is known. Constructing the requested three polynomials and two colliding points would resolve the Jacobian conjecture negatively, so a valid `FINAL_CERTIFICATE_JSON` cannot be supplied without a major new mathematical result.
